alana: Quick idea — small PLG experiment for next launch posts + webinar routing. 2-week test: give 50 starter credits to webinar registrants, and route them into either a guided prompt-template onboarding flow or a live product walkthrough queue. Goal: measure 7-day activation rate and first 3-run retention. mike: Love it. Narrow ask: how do we decide who gets which path? random split or signal-based? zoe: Random A/B is simplest for clean learnings. we can stratify by org-size signal if available. rory: We should also add a UTMs tag and metadata so sales can prioritize high-intent registrants. add field: utm_campaign=ignite-tribe and experiment_arm=A|B. alan a filename for the tracking sheet? alana: yes — I'll make a shared sheet. quick routing rules sketch: ```
if event == 'webinar_signup' then add_tag('ignite-tribe'); assign_experiment(random 50/50);
if experiment == 'A' then grant_credits(50); send_email(template='promptpack-onboard'); route_to='self-serve-path'
if experiment == 'B' then grant_credits(50); send_email(template='invite-product-walkthrough'); route_to='walkthrough-queue'
``` rory: nice. what about timing? do we wait to grant credits until after they attend? mike: I think grant on signup to reduce dropoff; include note: credits expire in 14 days, and we’ll nudge at day 3 and day 7. zoe: Measurement plan: primary = % users who generate >=1 meaningful output within 7 days; secondary = avg tokens used in 7 days, conversion to paid within 30 days. alana: Tracking keys: user_id, org_size_bucket, utm_campaign, experiment_arm, grant_ts, first_generation_ts, tokens_7d. rory: Ops ask — can marketing set the invite email copy? short, with clear CTA and quickstart template + 1-click claim. sample copy idea: "Claim your 50 credits and try 3 starter prompts built for your use case — no setup." mike: I'll draft copy and share. include prompt templates: short list of 3 starter prompts per persona. zoe: Also include an in-app banner for people arriving from webinar page with CTA "Claim credits" — we can A/B test banner vs. email-only. alana: Good call. we'll prioritize email+banner for arm A, email-only for arm B to test channel effect. launch-bot: New webinar registration count: 78 signups so far. alana: nice. action items: - alana: create tracking sheet + doc (deadline: tomorrow EOD) - mike: draft two email templates + 3 starter prompt templates (deadline: +48h) - zoe: set analytics events & cohort definitions (deadline: +72h) - rory: add routing rule to intake queue + UTM tagging (deadline: +72h) rory: any objections to budgeted credit amount? we estimated 50 credits ~ $0.20/user typical. mike: fine. small budget but enough to test behavior. zoe: one more: ensure we blacklist internal/test accounts and existing paid customers from the experiment. alana: will add exclusion logic. mike: cool — once copy is ready we can run a micro launch on the smaller segment before scaling. alana: sweet. ping me when drafts are in, I'll set up the shared doc and tag folks. :sparkles:
